primary_sources.title: A generalised Skolem-Mahler-Lech theorem for affine varieties
primary_sources.author: Jason P. Bell
primary_sources.venue: Journal of the London Mathematical Society 73 (2006), 367-379
primary_sources.exact_anchor: Abstract and main theorem: for an automorphism sigma of an affine variety Y, the return-time set {m : sigma^m(q) lies in X} is a finite union of complete doubly-infinite arithmetic progressions and a finite set.
primary_sources.supports: The established arithmetic-dynamics meaning of eventual periodicity/arithmetic-progressions in an autonomous algebraic orbit.
primary_sources.does_not_support: Nonexistence of the present coupled time-varying recurrence, divisor locking, phase-prime pigeonhole, or drift descent.

primary_sources.title: Prime Factors of Dynamical Sequences
primary_sources.author: Xander Faber and Andrew Granville
primary_sources.venue: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik 661 (2011), 189-214
primary_sources.exact_anchor: Abstract: for x_(n+1)=f(x_n), with one rational function f of degree at least two, non-eventual-periodicity forces a primitive prime factor of x_(n+1)-x_n for all sufficiently large n.
primary_sources.supports: A primary neighboring use of prime factors to distinguish eventually periodic and nonperiodic arithmetic orbits.
primary_sources.does_not_support: The converse direction, a nonautonomous multiplier cocycle, or the exact prime-scale descent used here.
